name: harness-fe
description: The agent that built it never leaves. A source-aware harness for every AI-built app — source-mapped build plugins, an MCP daemon, and a runtime client that let the agent keep watching, listening, and fixing the app long after it ships.

scripts.graph:html: turbo run build --graph=dep-graph.html && echo '→ open dep-graph.html'

pnpm.// onlyBuiltDependencies: Empty allowlist disables ALL install/postinstall scripts in our dependency tree. This is the primary defense against Shai-Hulud style postinstall worms. Add a package here ONLY if its postinstall is required AND audited.
